entry_method.description: Enter L01 on Medium from a new game or the linked preceding level; navigate to the scene before marking its interval.

route_actions.action: Begin tracing/capture before entry or verified checkpoint restore; log resident resources and initial state.
Play the complete normal Medium route; retain all scene/load boundaries, failures/retries, completion/tally and the next level (or ending for L10).
Record exact scene IDs, camera/route, input/tick sequence, assets and event outcomes; retain the following transition.

checkpoints.condition: First frame/state of the targeted scene
Complete level and linked progression event/action result
Level completion plus next-level load or final ending

start.condition: Before entry/load or verified restore request

scene_end.condition: Level completion plus next-level load or final ending

stop.condition: After result and following transition/unload are logged

capture_boundaries.display: Keep P2F proxy; record fullscreen/windowed capture override separately from the completed 4K prerequisite.

differential_trace_policy.expand_when: Resource/variant, spawn, damage, timing, route, phase or progression differs.
differential_trace_policy.unknown_differences: Remain pending; do not assume equality.

evidence.source_locator: Discovery target; exact route/phase not yet observed

open_questions: Recover exact route/checkpoint/scene IDs and tick/event bounds from this build.
Confirm candidate asset categories and split additional observed phases/routes into stable scenarios.
